Name: A New traveller---Yue
Author: Disnamable
Description:
[center][color=#00ff00][size=5]Yue[/size][/color][size=4] is a wandering traveler who arrived in Pelican Town not long ago. Will this be her final stop? [/size][/center]
[center][size=4]She lives a peculiar life. She resides in a basement by the sea, yet very few people know where she stays. [/size][/center]
[center][size=4]She loves collecting odd trinkets from her travels, such as trees that grow frozen crystal orbs.
She holds a secret. She might share it with you, but don’t tell anyone before a certain point in time. [/size][/center]
[center][size=4]She holds a hidden identity — can you uncover it? [/size][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45781/45781-1790002571-2057701530.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][quote][size=5]Marriageable NPC
Over 10 new heart events
Over 10 new crops
9 fruit trees [/size]

[size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45781/45781-1779663443-1677210756.png[/img][/size]

[size=5] Over 10 new fish
3 custom maps
7 custom community center bundles
Custom spouse room and patio
...
Magical items with unique special abilities included!!
May they bring you blessings and good fortune.[/size][/quote][/center]
[center][size=5]She loves sleeping in and usually gets up very late in the morning. [/size][/center]
[center][size=5]She joins [color=#00ff00]Caroline[/color]’s fitness club every Tuesday. [/size][/center]
[center][size=5]Her favorite gifts are starfruit, ancient fruit, and salad. [/size][/center]
[center][size=5]She also adores prismatic shards and rabbit’s feet. [/size][/center]
[center][size=5][color=#9900ff]Abigail[/color] and [color=#ff7700]Penny[/color] are her closest friends.[/size][/center]
[center]
[color=#cc0000][size=6] To truly understand who she is, the farmer will need to befriend her. [/size][/color][/center]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45781/45781-1779662363-570517819.png[/img][/center]
[center]
[quote][left][size=5]# 0.5 Heart Event: You can meet her at the Saloon between 8 PM and 9 PM on Friday nights. [/size]
[size=5]# 1 Heart Event: You can meet her at Pierre's General Store from 12 PM to 4 PM. [/size]
[size=5]# 2 Heart Event: You can meet her at Robin's house between 8 AM and 10 AM. [/size]
[size=5]# 4 Heart Event: You can meet her at the Library from 9 AM to 12 PM. [/size]
[size=5]# 6 Heart Event: You can meet her at Haley's house between 2 PM and 4 PM. [/size]
[size=5]# 8 Heart Event: Receive her mail, then meet her at the Mountain Lake after asking her out on a date. [/size]
[size=5]# 11 Heart Event: You can meet her on the beach between 10 PM and 12 AM during rainy nights.[/size][/left]
[left][size=5]......[/size]

[center][color=#274e13][size=6] And there are plenty more heart events to discover!!! [/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=6][color=#9900ff][img width=48,height=96]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45781/45781-1779664214-807360050.png[/img]  Maybe more story interactions with Abigail?[img width=48,height=96]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45781/45781-1779664145-613025975.png[/img][/color][/size][/center]
[/left]
[/quote][size=6]This is only Version 4.0.1! [/size]
[size=6] More updates are planned for the future.[/size][/center]
[center][size=6]4.1.0 is coming soon.[/size]

[quote][left][size=6] Compatibility [/size]
[size=5] Compatible with major mods such as SVE, RSV, East Scarp, Sunberry and more. [/size][/left]
[left][size=5]There are no known compatibility issues at this time.
Please report to me if you encounter any compatibility conflicts or unknown bugs.[/size]
[/left]
[/quote][left][size=4]If you'd like to contribute portraits, sprites, textures and other assets for Yue, you are more than welcome to do so.
Also welcome anyone who wants to provide i18n translations for this mod. [/size][/left]
[left][size=4]Currently supports [/size][size=6]Chinese, French，German, English, Spanish, Vietnamese[/size][size=6]. [/size][/left]
[left][size=4]Vietnamese and German translations require downloading separate translation mods. [/size][/left]
[left][size=4]All translations except Chinese, Vietnamese , and German are AI-generated. Native speakers and other volunteers are invited to submit human-corrected translations. [/size][/left]
[left][size=4]This mod is exclusively released on Nexus Mods, and I am the sole creator. Any other uploads claiming to be this mod are counterfeit. [/size][/left]

Downloads.Description:
4.0.1版本：
增加了对肖像图片的兼容性。旧版本在一定程度上只兼容了原版游戏的对话框中的肖像展示方法，这个版本则提高了mod对肖像展示的其他方法的兼容性。
